kind: offline scripted tool calls: state/tool/guard logic, not NLU

scenarios.checks: UI start set, then explicitly cleared (start=null): nearest exit asks for the start (missing_start), no route from the old room, no nearest() call
a UI start that the UI no longer sends (key omitted, older clients) is dropped too
a start the USER stated (update_session) survives turns without a UI start; the exit route then starts there and ends at an exit door
destination=null from the UI clears the destination: plan_route with null endpoints fails honestly (missing_endpoint) instead of reusing the old destination
wheelchair user, only lift closed (confirmed scenario), destination on another floor; model passes step_free=false: request stays step-free, unreachable, no stairs, constraint note returned
lift closed, find_nearest exit with step_free=false from F1: nearest() still asked step-free, no exit offered, no route, constraint note
what-if (assume_closed=[lift]) for a step-free user: unreachable, no stairs; the real scenario is untouched and the next route uses the open lift again
lift closed in precision mode, model drops step_free: failed honestly (no official fallback, mode stays precision), step-free request, constraint note, no route shown
step-free survives a UI mode switch to precision and back and a new turn; the official route then uses the lift, never the stairs
UI building switch keeps step-free and width but clears start, destination and the previous building's conversation
only an explicit user change lifts step-free: UI toggle off, back on via update_session, then the user lifts it; only then a stairs route (lift closed) is ok
reroute after a scenario change by another consumer: same session endpoints, step-free still requested, now unreachable without stairs
a precision route echoes the binding width; a UI mode switch keeps width/safety
inspected machine reaches the model context by name; start/destination untouched
an unknown inspected item is dropped (not kept from before); the 'selection' alias works; inspected=null clears
exact map-point start routes to an exit door: point start (requested XY) and final opening position preserved
a map point in an unknown room is refused with a ui_note; no fallback to the earlier start
a map point far outside its room polygon is refused at sync (ui_note), not stored as 'a point in Office 1.04'
scenarios.defect: sync_ui/check_endpoint only checks that the point's space exists, not that the position lies inside it (the error text claims 'not inside a room'); the bad point is stored and the router refuses it only later

scenarios.checks: successive vertical moves (campus): F0->F4 by lift, then from the arrival room F4->F1; floors visited in order, the second route starts where the first arrived
propose closing the lift changes nothing; Confirm applies it, drops the stale last_route, the proposal cannot be confirmed twice; the next turn sees the closure
a cancelled proposal changes nothing and the model is told it was cancelled
missing referent ('the biggest one'): a clarifying text-only turn mutates nothing (state, UI, navigation calls)
'the second one' resolves from the previous turn's ranked results: the model context carries the found places in order (name = kind:id); the route goes to the second
search returns an opening (exit) and an asset; routes to them keep the typed endpoint: the exit route ends at the door, the asset route targets the asset (not room centre)
an opening id passed as a space is refused (unknown_place), no router call, no guessing of another type
pose heading 0 deg (CCW from +X): the corridor door due east is 'ahead'; the direction filter keeps only that side; heading normalised to [0, 360)
pose heading 90 deg (CCW from +X): the corridor door due east is 'right'; the direction filter keeps only that side; heading normalised to [0, 360)
pose heading 180 deg (CCW from +X): the corridor door due east is 'behind'; the direction filter keeps only that side; heading normalised to [0, 360)
pose heading -90 deg (CCW from +X): the corridor door due east is 'left'; the direction filter keeps only that side; heading normalised to [0, 360)
server racks in the next room are reported 'behind a wall', never visible; things in the own room are visible
unknown view direction: no sides are given and the result tells the model to ask; the direction filter is not applied
no pose (cleared): describe_surroundings refuses (missing_pose) instead of guessing
leak in Office 1.04: room_stacked below = the largest-overlap room on F0 (Hall access 0.19), highlighted; no route, no state change
room_stacked below the ground floor and malformed arguments are honest errors (invalid_input), nothing invented
a joke/thanks turn without tools passes the reply through and mutates nothing (no navigation call, state and step-free unchanged)
activity recap counts only motion/arrivals inside a navigation; preview motion, a duplicate arrival and motion after arrival do not count; paused time excluded
two assistant sessions are isolated; a reset session comes back without the old pose, start, step-free or history
a deleted activity session cannot be appended to or read again; new ids are fresh
demo and test sessions are labelled synthetic in the recap; real ones are not
find_places and find_nearest (no route) only highlight: start and destination stay, no endpoints/route in the UI payload, no router call
preview_closure for a step-free user reports consequences but changes neither the scenario, the revision, the session nor creates a proposal
'Clear simulated location' (start=null, pose=null) really clears: surroundings and nearest refuse, the model sees no start/pose
session step-free + find_nearest(step_free=false, and_route): nearest() and the route request are step-free; the route uses the lift
a tool argument step_free=true tightens the session and the next route stays step-free
fault injection: a router that ignores step_free returns a stairs route; the assistant's guard turns it into 'no step-free route', shows no route and records a failed route
lift closed, step-free nearest toilet with route: the same-floor toilet is chosen (the closer one downstairs is not offered via stairs), no vertical transition
precision + step-free + width/safety from the UI: the route request and the route's own constraints echo exactly the session settings (guidance reroutes reuse them)
precision with a 1.0 m width that no door path supports: failed with the 'offer official' hint, no silent official route, width and mode unchanged, one router call
precision mode with a required width of 1.0 m: find_nearest must not rank kitchens whose only doors are 0.9 m as reachable
scenarios.defect: find_nearest ignores the session width (NavigationPort.nearest has no width parameter): Kitchen 0.28 behind a 0.9 m door is ranked first for a 1.0 m width

scenarios.checks: UI start with start_source='simulation' is labelled known_from='simulation' in the snapshot and in the session_state the model sees
UI start with start_source=None is labelled known_from='manual' in the snapshot and in the session_state the model sees
UI start with start_source='qr' is labelled known_from='qr' in the snapshot and in the session_state the model sees
UI start with start_source='hypothesis' is labelled known_from='hypothesis' in the snapshot and in the session_state the model sees
an unsupported source (e.g. an experimental image estimate) must not be labelled 'manual' (= user-confirmed)
scenarios.defect: sync_ui maps any unknown start_source to 'manual', so an unverified estimate is presented to the model as a manually confirmed position

scenarios.checks: a start the user states after an earlier QR start must not inherit the stale 'qr' label
scenarios.defect: update_session (and plan_route) set state.start but never start_source; the previous UI source ('qr') stays and is shown as known_from for the new start

scenarios.checks: invalid poses are discarded, never kept from the previous turn: foreign-building room, non-finite position; a non-finite heading becomes 'unknown'
a pose whose position lies far outside its claimed room is discarded
scenarios.defect: _check_pose only checks that the space id exists and the XY is finite; a pose 60 m away from Office 1.04 is accepted and describe_surroundings answers from it

scenarios.checks: 'how far is it from the kitchen to the lab?' (plan_route with an explicit other start) must not relocate the user: the next nearest search still starts at Office 1.04
scenarios.defect: tool_plan_route writes an explicit start into session.state['start'] (and keeps the old start_source), so a route between two other places moves the user

scenarios.checks: unknown room ids from the model give unknown_place for route and update_session; start and destination are untouched; no router call
select_building: unknown id refused; a real switch clears start, proposals and history (the old proposal cannot be confirmed); an unknown UI building is refused and the state stays
